a.d: In Ponta Grossa, Sunday is for family: lunch, park and a nap. Express shared plans: “A gente vai…”. Note that “a gente” (lit. the people) is the casual form of “nós”. False friend: “domingo” (Sunday) vs “dominar” (to dominate).
